filters.rule: Resolve to a list of trait names from trait_features, then trait_name IN (list). trait_grouping matches trait_group exactly; structure_measured and keywords match by substring (case-sensitive) against the field; all selected parts are intersected. No matching trait means zero rows, not no filter.

Only the field named by taxon_type is used: family IN (...), genus IN (...) or taxon_name IN (...). Browser expands the choice to the full family, genus, taxon_name conjunction from taxa so row-group statistics prune on raw_by_taxon.
IN (...); the species table has no such column, so the input is ignored (and cleared in the interface) for species averages
IN (...); ignored for species averages, as above
latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL, then optional >= and <= bounds on latitude (deg) and longitude (deg); columns are numeric in the data files
regexp_matches(taxon_distribution, pattern) where pattern is the escaped selected values joined with |

filters.rule_controlled: column IN (...) except dataset_id on species, which is a whole-element match inside a '; '-joined list: regexp_matches(dataset_id, '(^|; )(a|b)(;|$)')
filters.rule_free_text: regexp_matches(lower(column), pattern); text is split on |, trimmed, lower-cased, escaped, and joined with |
